resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR's details give 6,014 ft (1,833 m), its description gives 5,999 ft, and Peakbagging gives 6,008 ft. The record's 1,833.1 m matches the NHLR details, and the story uses the register figure.

notes_for_editor: Current access and rental status are not stated in any source read. The NHLR entry is dated 2017 and the Peakbagging photo is from 2011, so the status is at least several years old. The 1962 hire is known only from an Oakdale newspaper as quoted on the Forest Lookouts site; the story now says she took a summer job as a fire lookout, which is the newspaper's wording. The rental finding is negative: the FFLA California list (checked 2026-10-08) shows ten rentals, none at Woods Ridge. Staffing as_of is 2017, the NHLR's status date. Verification 2026-10-08: the advice to ask the ranger district and not to climb the tower was removed because no source supports it.
